verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling platform. The only relevant evidence is the Reclaim 2.0 note that you can "preview changes in your calendar before deploying them," which works as a dry-run of AI scheduling changes rather than a true isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test account/environment, isolated test data separate from real calendars, a developer/API test mode (no OpenAPI spec was found), detailed documentation of the preview feature, and independent hands-on corroboration.
